remainingDecisions: For the Fed and both BEA claims, obtain authoritative issue-time provenance and source-specific later editorial receipts before changing sourceReleaseAt in the pinned Weekly JSON. A documented scheduled time alone is not a verified actual issuer posting time.
For GDP, human reviewer must reconcile canonical exact pinned /news/ URL versus the existing curated /index.php/news/ outcome URL without asserting equality from appearance alone.
Every exact-item reuse, international/commercial/attribution/retention decision remains DENIED pending qualified reviewer; no current publication/Preview/merge approval.
No historical generation timestamp may be rewritten and no future Monthly may count this unpublished Weekly.

For the BLS ECI claim, distinguish the already reviewed 12:30 UTC official release/issue time from the not-independently-observed exact web posting instant; do not relabel the official time as a server posting timestamp.

evidenceSemantics.scheduledReleaseAtUtc: Curated schedule or agency-announced standard issued time; does not certify live website posting or the time an editor inspected the source
evidenceSemantics.recordedEditorialSourceReleaseAtUtc: A time pinned in a pre-existing approved Daily/Weekly editorial receipt; the value's existence does not independently authenticate web-server posting
evidenceSemantics.exactIssuerActualPublicationAtUtc: Only populate with directly authenticated item-specific issuer publication metadata/receipt. A schedule, Daily generatedAt, Git commit or post-release owner comment is not enough
evidenceSemantics.verifiedPostReleaseClaimReceipt: A dated source-specific editorial provenance receipt, not a data redistribution or commercial rights approval
